Hawa Mahal.title: Hawa Mahal
Hawa Mahal.extract: Hawa Mahal is a palace in Jaipur, India. It is constructed of red and pink sandstone and was built in 1799 by Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh.

City Palace, Jaipur.title: City Palace, Jaipur
City Palace, Jaipur.extract: The City Palace complex includes the Chandra Mahal and Mubarak Mahal palaces and other buildings.

Jantar Mantar, Jaipur.title: Jantar Mantar, Jaipur
Jantar Mantar, Jaipur.extract: The Jantar Mantar is a collection of nineteen architectural astronomical instruments.

Birla Mandir, Jaipur.title: Birla Mandir, Jaipur
Birla Mandir, Jaipur.extract: Laxmi Narayan Temple, popularly Birla Mandir, is a Hindu temple in Jaipur.

Jal Mahal.title: Jal Mahal
Jal Mahal.description: Palace in the middle of Man Sagar Lake in Jaipur
Jal Mahal.extract: Jal Mahal is a palace in the middle of the Man Sagar Lake.

Albert Hall Museum.title: Albert Hall Museum
Albert Hall Museum.extract: The Albert Hall Museum is the oldest museum of the state of Rajasthan.

Jaipur.title: Jaipur
Jaipur.extract: Jaipur is the capital and largest city of the Indian state of Rajasthan, known as the Pink City.

Jaipur Railway Station.title: Jaipur Railway Station
Jaipur Railway Station.extract: Jaipur Junction is the main railway station of Jaipur.
